learning_outcomes.text: Describe the fundamental concepts of cybersecurity, from data protection to the main threats and vulnerabilities of digital systems, and explain the principles underlying the secure use of cryptography and software development.
Use methods, tools and techniques to analyze and improve the security of software, data and systems, including through practical testing and fuzzing activities.
Identify, examine and evaluate the characteristics and properties of software programs and systems relevant to security, selecting appropriate countermeasures against the threats considered.
Describe and motivate the technical choices adopted in the analysis and protection of software, data and systems.
Independently deepen the methodologies presented and acquire further practical experience with tools and techniques for the security of software, data and systems.

syllabus_topics: Software Testing (from theory to fuzzing hands-on)
assessment_rules: The practical test involves answering questions on the computer and lasts two hours. Please refer to the course page for examples of questions.
bibliography: Slides and resources provided by the lecturers
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
